name: nominal_motion
purpose: bounded delay, bias, scale, noise and constant camera translation

name: stationary_null
purpose: zero velocity: old pixels alone do not imply position error

name: delay_jitter
purpose: larger variable transport delay; same clock contract

name: drop_duplicate_reorder
purpose: loss, retransmission and out-of-order arrival; sequence guards

name: observable_wrong_id
purpose: reported marker ID differs: all methods reject it

name: hidden_wrong_association
purpose: wrong feature carries expected ID; no oracle detection

name: wrong_clock_bounds
purpose: actual clock mapping exceeds frozen bound

name: wrong_calibration_bounds
purpose: actual spatial bias exceeds frozen bound
